title: Chrome browser profiles
whyItMatters: Each Chrome profile is a separate browsing identity with its own sign-ins. Their names show how many identities were kept on this Mac.
source: Chromium user data directory docs, macOS profile layout: https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/main/docs/user_data_dir.md
notes: Matches Preferences, which every real profile has, so sibling folders such as Crash Reports are not matched. Profile folders are Default, Profile 1, ...

cleanup.exportFirst: In Chrome save bookmarks with the bookmark manager export, and export any saved passwords you need.
cleanup.signOut: In Chrome open Settings > You and Google and choose Turn off, so the Google account keeps its data but stops trusting this Mac.
steps: Close every Chrome window so the profile files are not in use.
Move Google Chrome to the Trash from Applications and empty the Trash.
Delete the Google/Chrome folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes every Chrome profile on this Mac: history, cookies, saved logins and extensions.
cleanup.source: Google Chrome Help, Sign in and sync in Chrome: https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/185277
